assertion: The Lumo bowl's rim had no crack at the 17:00 handover-bench inspection on 9 September 2027.
draft_context:
The studio report describes the bowl before wrapping.

The Lumo bowl's rim had no crack at the 17:00 handover-bench inspection on 9 September 2027.

sources.text:
Pottery studio notebook, 9 September 2027

In the daylight inspection, Kesta's glaze was cobalt blue and glossy. Tavi's glaze was ochre and glossy. These entries record surface color and appearance; the notebook contains no washing observations.

At the 17:00 handover-bench inspection, before the Lumo bowl was wrapped, I examined its rim. The rim was continuous and had no crack.

Signed, Iona, studio potter

Studio bulletin, 10 September 2027

Kesta: cobalt-blue gloss. Kesta's glaze is dishwasher-proof.

Production note: The Kesta wording was assembled only from the 9 September notebook's color and gloss entry. No washing report was used for the caption.

I also attended the Lumo bowl's 17:00 handover-bench inspection on 9 September, before wrapping. I examined its rim during that inspection and saw a hairline crack through the rim.

Signed, Oren, bulletin editor
